notes: Zero findings. Independent second pass on the SSO backend chain: all three files match §4.5/§4.6/§4.7 exactly, with the nothing-else-changes property proven by direct git diff over the reviewed range rather than the pre-dumped file alone. The §4.5 session-ride chain was traced into the bundled gems: actionpack-6.1.7.7 ActionDispatch::Request::Session#[]= and #delete both stringify keys (so the lambda's symbol write and the controller's symbol delete agree under both the :json cookie round-trip and the same-request/controller-spec path), and omniauth-2.0.4 stores request.GET (string keys) for env['omniauth.params'], so request_phase_params.merge(tracking_from_session) is string-keyed end to end, matching the four string-key merged_tracking reads. Settled rulings respected: M1 (uncapped session ride), M3 (bracket keys 400), and the LOW-list setup-lambda callback-phase overwrite were re-encountered and not re-flagged. Prior finding l1-run4-001: verified resolved for my area — §11 note 4's amended text ('the 255-code-unit surrogate-safe cap (5.1 rule 2)') and §7 constraint 1's '254 when the slice would split a surrogate pair' accurately describe the shipped sanitizeTrackingValue (slice(0, 255) then drop a trailing code unit in 0xD800-0xDBFF); the code is unchanged at fc3f047f9. One procedural note on my own work: an initial writer-sweep grep used \s in POSIX ERE (not supported by git grep -E) and silently missed the organizations_controller assignments; it was re-run with [[:space:]] and the corrected results are what is reported above.
